text: The presentation by Kemba Byam, Acting Manager, The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, Social Development, Finance, and Administration and Dr. Akwatu Khenti, Director, Community Resources Section, Social Development, Finance, and Administration will outline the mandate and work of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit at the City of Toronto and will provide and update an overview of the recommendations and priorities identified in Year 5 of the Toronto Action Plan to Confront Anti-Black Racism.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
